entities.summary: Learner Tien is an American professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 21 achieved on 16 March 2026 and a best doubles ranking of No. 343 reached on 18 August 2025. His best achievement is reaching a major quarterfinal at the 2026 Australian Open. He is currently the No. 5 American singles player.
